~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ vss-a25-l25 building router hsrp ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
vlan 3737
  name PHSG01-MANLAN
!
!
interface Port-channel2
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 3737
!
interface vlan3737
  description PHSG01-MANLAN
  mtu 9216
  ip address 10.45.56.190 255.255.255.192
  no shutdown
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ bldg05-sw01-04 building distribution switch ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
vlan 3737
  name PHSG01-MANLAN
!
interface Port-channel1
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 3737
!
interface Port-channel2
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 3737
!
interface Port-channel3
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 3737
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END #############
